svg.title: Tyche in Unicode block characters
svg.desc: Tyche with her crown, child, and cornucopia, drawn on a 200-column, 100-row grid of Unicode shading characters. Each visible character has its own fixed position; blank cells are omitted. All artwork is editable text, with no embedded bitmap.

g.font-family: Menlo, Consolas, DejaVu Sans Mono, monospace
